title: Chemical analysis by observation of spectra
lineage: Inspected primary text or later historical source; see locator and qualification.

passages.locator: Opening paragraphs; sodium and lithium sections
passages.note: Kirchhoff and Bunsen described qualitative chemical analysis using characteristic bright spectral lines, focusing on alkali and alkaline-earth metals. Earlier spectral observations preceded this paper. The English excerpt is a later presentation of the 1860 German work.
